description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of narrative media framing in political discourse across three years: 2017, 2018, and 2019. The chart is divided into three colored segments, each representing a specific year and its corresponding percentage of the total. The largest segment, colored blue, represents the year 2019 and accounts for 46% of the total, with a value of (46) displayed inside the slice. The orange segment, representing 2018, constitutes 33.0% of the total, with the value (33) shown within the slice. The green segment, corresponding to 2017, makes up 21.0% of the total, with the value (21) inside the slice. The segments are arranged in a clockwise direction starting from the top, with the 2019 segment at the top, followed by 2018 on the left, and 2017 on the right. Each segment is labeled with its respective year and percentage, and the chart includes a legend indicating the color associated with each year. The visual representation emphasizes the relative proportions of narrative media framing for each year, with 2019 being the most prominent.
